choice.basis: Chart: Mountain Snowpack Temperature Record shows a steady decline from 24.0°C in 2005 to 10.0°C in 2015 (14.0°C drop). Task: Routing criterion is 'Whether the full-period mountain snowpack temperature change requires substantial-change follow-up'. A 14°C drop over the review period is a substantial change, not ordinary variation.
choice.option_label: Route the 2005 to 2015 mountain snowpack temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
